activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate the understanding of basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (a) Form words using word-formation processes that express clarity and fluency in oral and written communications
suggested_methods: Discussion: In manageable groups, guide students through discussing the processes of forming words
TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide students through thinking and writing down various words and predict on their formation
activities.assessment_criteria: Word formation processes are used properly to express clarity and fluency in oral and written communications
suggested_resources: audio-visual materials for word formation process

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate the understanding of basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (b) Pronounce words correctly using stress and intonation in oral and written communications
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Use video to guide students through pronouncing word stress and intonation, bang the tables, clap hands, put brackets to show a stressed part of the word and arrows to show the types of intonation
Discussion: In manageable groups, guide students through pronouncing simple words and sentences with stress and intonation
Song: Guide students through identifying word and sentence stress and intonation from the song
activities.assessment_criteria: Words are pronounced properly by using stress and intonation in oral and written communications

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate the understanding of basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (c) Interpret literal meanings of words and sentences in various contexts
suggested_methods: Role-play: Guide students through acting out and interpreting literal meanings of key words and sentences as they appeared in the role-plays
Dialogue: Guide students through practising a dialogue while observing the proposed words and interpreting literal meanings of the words and sentences as they have been used in the dialogue
activities.assessment_criteria: Literal meanings of words and sentences are interpreted properly in various contexts

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate the understanding of basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (d) Evaluate the importance of stress and intonation in oral communications
suggested_methods: Debate: Guide students through debating to evaluate the importance of stress and intonation in oral communication
Dramatisation: Guide students through dramatising a simple play with elements of wrong and right stresses and intonation, and evaluate the importance of stress and intonation in oral communication
activities.assessment_criteria: Stress and intonation in oral communication are evaluated appropriately

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Apply principles of language to construct sentences, paragraphs, and texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Write different sentences using appropriate punctuation marks
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide students through discussing different uses of punctuation marks
Gallery-walk: Guide students through writing different sentences by using appropriate punctuation marks
activities.assessment_criteria: Punctuation marks are used appropriately in writing different sentences
suggested_resources: audio-visual materials for word formation process

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Apply principles of language to construct sentences, paragraphs, and texts
activities.learning_activity: (b) Construct paragraphs using appropriate steps in writing texts
suggested_methods: Jig-saw: Guide students through constructing paragraphs using proper steps in writing texts (pre-writing, researching, drafting, revising, editing and proofreading)
Gallery-walk: Guide students through constructing paragraphs by using proper steps of writing texts
activities.assessment_criteria: Paragraphs are constructed appropriately in writing texts

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Apply principles of language to construct sentences, paragraphs, and texts
activities.learning_activity: (c) Compose essays using appropriate structure
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide students through composing essays and describing their structures
activities.assessment_criteria: Essays are composed appropriately

activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of the use of English in academic communication
activities.learning_activity: (a) Participate in dialogues and debates to discuss discipline-specific matters (e.g., markets, politics, education, health, etc.)
suggested_methods: Dialogue, debate, discussion: With selected topics or issues, guide students through debating, discussing and doing dialogues on the discipline-specific matters in markets, politics, education, health and so on to determine their mastery of using English language in academic communication
activities.assessment_criteria: Discipline-specific matters are discussed well in dialogues and debates
suggested_resources: texts (sample of minutes and agenda from meetings)
influential people (politicians, preachers, motivational speakers, etc.) for discipline-specific matters

activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of the use of English in academic communication
activities.learning_activity: (b) Participate in formal and informal meetings (e.g., school, workplace, home, village, ward)
suggested_methods: Dramatisation: Guide students through dramatising and identifying skills required to participate in formal and informal meetings
Simulation: Guide students through identifying skills required to participate in formal and informal meetings through simulation
Guest speaker/ Resource person: Invite a political leader/ a motivational speaker/ a resource person to give speeches for students to observe and learn the skills applied during the presentation
Discussion: In manageable groups, guide students through discussion to identify the skills required to conduct formal and informal meetings
activities.assessment_criteria: Formal and informal meetings are conducted properly

activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of the use of English in academic communication
activities.learning_activity: (c) Narrate diverse events/activities/stories orally and in written communication
suggested_methods: Story-telling: Guide students through narrating the events or activities experienced orally and in writing
Songs: Guide students through singing to narrate events and activities they experienced in their families
activities.assessment_criteria: Diverse events/activities/life experiences are narrated appropriately

activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Prepare different documents in English
activities.learning_activity: (a) Prepare posters for academic presentations
suggested_methods: Project work: Guide students through preparing banners, sign-posts and logos for academic purposes
TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide individual students through thinking and creating banners, sign-posts, posters and logos for academic presentations
activities.assessment_criteria: posters, logos, and banners are created properly for various academic purposes
suggested_resources: references and citations for preparation of different documents in English

activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Use ICT to search for academic information
activities.learning_activity: (a) Search for academic information from physical and online sources
suggested_methods: Scenario: Guide students through assessing how the library resources are used to obtain academic information
Project work: Organise students in manageable groups and assign students some activities that require them to utilise online-library in order to search for academic information
activities.assessment_criteria: Library resources are utilised properly to obtain academic information

activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Use ICT to search for academic information
activities.learning_activity: (b) Assess the importance of different basic databases in learning
suggested_methods: Project work: Organise manageable groups and assign students tasks to assess the importance of different basic databases in learning
Discussion: Guide students through discussing how physical and online archives are important in obtaining academic information.
activities.assessment_criteria: Archives are used properly to obtain information

activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Use ICT to search for academic information
activities.learning_activity: (c) Participate in face-to-face research interviews to collect information
suggested_methods: Scenario: Create a scenario that will guide students to identify the skills required to conduct face to face interview
Simulation: Guide students through conducting face to face interviews to collect information
activities.assessment_criteria: Face-to-face research interviews are conducted properly to collect information

activities.specific_competence: 2.4 Prepare and make academic presentations in English
activities.learning_activity: (a) Make classroom presentations
suggested_methods: Scenario: Guide students through preparing and making classroom presentations of proposals and reports
Discussion: Guide students through discussing on how to make classroom presentations
Demonstration: Guide students through presenting proposals and reports in the classroom to develop presentation skills
Presentations: Guide students through making classroom presentation on the project works and reports
activities.assessment_criteria: Research proposals and research reports are presented appropriately
suggested_resources: social media (Facebook, YouTube) for academic presentations in English

activities.specific_competence: 2.5 Demonstrate mastery of using illustrations in academic documents
activities.learning_activity: (a) Identify simple and complex illustrations from various documents
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Guide students through identifying simple and complex illustrations from various documents
RIPS (Read-Ink-Pair-Share): Provide students with books, maps, journals, articles, computers for everyone to identify simple and complex illustrations
activities.assessment_criteria: Simple and complex visual aids are identified properly from various documents
suggested_resources: Internet for identifying simple and complex illustrations

activities.specific_competence: 2.5 Demonstrate mastery of using illustrations in academic documents
activities.learning_activity: (b) Interpret simple illustrations used in documents
suggested_methods: Scenarios: Using a scenario method, guide students through interpreting simple and complex illustrations used in various documents.
RIPS (Read-Ink-Pair-Share): Provide students with books, maps, journals, articles, computers for everyone to interpret simple and complex illustrations
activities.assessment_criteria: Simple visual aids used in documents are interpreted properly

activities.specific_competence: 2.5 Demonstrate mastery of using illustrations in academic documents
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use simple illustrations to prepare academic documents
suggested_methods: Project work: Ask students to prepare academic documents with simple illustrations such as bar charts, graphs, photograph, etc. and associate them with research proposals and reports done in 2.4
activities.assessment_criteria: Simple visual aids are used properly to prepare academic documents

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (a) Construct sentences (complex, compound, etc.) by observing subject-verb agreement and appropriate word order in oral and written communications
suggested_methods: TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide individual students through constructing sentences of different types and writing them down for presentation
Dialogue: Guide students through conversations to discuss the sentences used in the dialogue
activities.assessment_criteria: Sentences (complex, compound, etc.) are constructed properly by observing subject-verb agreement and appropriate word order
suggested_resources: oral and written texts on various fields for sentence construction

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (b) Justify the necessity of word order in sentence construction
suggested_methods: Scenarios: Guide students through justifying the necessity of word order in sentence construction
Debate: Guide students through debating on whether it is necessary or not to have word order in sentences construction
activities.assessment_criteria: The necessity of word order in sentence construction is justified

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use field-specific vocabularies (e.g., science, commerce, agriculture, etc.) in oral and written communication
suggested_methods: Scenarios: Prepare a scenario that will guide students to identify field specific vocabularies and present them to the class
Project work: Assign students to do practical activities in science, commerce, agriculture, etc. and write reports on the performed practicals
activities.assessment_criteria: Field-specific vocabulary (e.g., science, commerce, agriculture, etc.) are used appropriately in oral and written communications.

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
activities.learning_activity: (d) Interpret implied meanings of words and sentences in various contexts
suggested_methods: Role-play: Prepare role-plays with words and sentences that will help students to interpret their implied meanings
Dialogue: Guide students through speaking out the words and sentences to interpret implied meanings
activities.assessment_criteria: Implied meanings of words and sentences are interpreted correctly in various context

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Apply principles of language to construct sentences, paragraphs and texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Write various reports using appropriate procedures
suggested_methods: Project work: Guide students through preparing different reports, and let them present the report to the class
Simulation: Ask students to simulate a situation for a meeting and guide them through writing reports from the meetings
Demonstration: Prepare samples of memos and various reports, and guide students through reading and differentiating them
TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide students through writing various reports and formal letters
activities.assessment_criteria: Various reports are written properly
suggested_resources: reports and memos for writing various reports

activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of the use of English in academic communication
activities.learning_activity: (a) Make presentations on diverse matters (e.g., health, death, celebration, etc.) and contexts (e.g., school, home, workplace, etc.) using informative skills
suggested_methods: Role-play: Guide students through reporting on diverse matters (e.g., health, death, celebration, etc.) and contexts (e.g., school, home, workplace, etc.) using informative skills through role-play
Study-tour: Guide students through visiting the nearby radio and Television stations to participate in interviews using informative skills
Role-play: Guide students through role-playing job interviews using informative skills
activities.assessment_criteria: Diverse matters (e.g., health, death, celebration, etc.) and contexts (e.g., school, home, workplace) are reported
suggested_resources: etc. for making presentations on diverse matters

activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Prepare different documents in English
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use e-mails, fax, online professional platforms (e.g., LinkedIn) and online portals (e.g., Ajira portal) to communicate information
suggested_methods: Questions and Answers (Q&A); Project Work: Guide students through identifying on-line professional platforms through oral questions and answers
Project Work: Assign students to use e-mails, fax, LinkedIn, Ajira portal to communicate information and guide them through discussing to identify their effectiveness
activities.assessment_criteria: E-mails, fax, online professional platforms (e.g., LinkedIn) and online portals (e.g., Ajira portal) are used properly to communicate information

activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Prepare different documents in English
activities.learning_activity: (b) Write project proposals and project reports
suggested_methods: RIPS (Read-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide students through visiting a library, searching for important elements in writing project proposals and project reports and sharing with the whole class
Discussion: Organise students in manageable groups and guide them through discussing and writing project proposals and project reports
activities.assessment_criteria: Project proposals and project reports are written properly

activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Prepare different documents in English
activities.learning_activity: (c) Write references and citations in academic documents manually and by using software (e.g., Mendeley, Endnote, etc.)
suggested_methods: TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide students through assessing different documents with different citations and referencing done manually and by using software
Jig-saw: Guide students through writing references and citations in academic documents manually, and by using software (e.g., Mendeley, Endnote, etc.) for presentation
activities.assessment_criteria: References and citations are written correctly in academic documents using software

activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Use ICT to search for academic information
activities.learning_activity: (a) Conduct online research interviews to collect information
suggested_methods: Scenario: Create a scenario that can help students to identify the skills required to conduct online research interviews
Simulation: Guide students through conducting online research interviews to collect information
Project work: Assign activities to students in groups and guide them through using online/virtual library to obtain academic information
activities.assessment_criteria: Online/virtual libraries are utilised appropriately to obtain information
suggested_resources: online journals/archives/libraries special apps (e.g., Zoom, MS-Teams, Google Meet)

activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Use ICT to search for academic information
activities.learning_activity: (b) Assess the importance of different basic databases in learning
suggested_methods: Case study: Guide students through assessing the importance of different basic data bases in learning
Debate: Guide students through debating on the usefulness and importance of different basic databases in learning
Project work: Organise manageable groups of students and assign them some tasks that require discussion on the importance of different basic databases in learning
activities.assessment_criteria: Importance of different basic databases in learning is assessed properly

activities.specific_competence: 2.4 Prepare and make academic presentations in English
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use multimedia devices (e.g., computer, projector, TV, etc.) in oral presentations
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Ask students to use multimedia devices (e.g., computer, projector, TV, etc.) in oral presentations
Project work: Guide students through preparing presentations on various cross-cutting issues using multimedia devices (e.g., computer, projector, TV, etc.)
activities.assessment_criteria: Multimedia devices (e.g., computer, projector, TV, etc.) are used appropriately in oral presentations
suggested_resources: special apps (e.g., Zoom, MS-Teams, Google Meeting) for multimedia use

activities.specific_competence: 2.4 Prepare and make academic presentations in English
activities.learning_activity: (b) Present project proposals and project reports
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Guide students through presenting project proposals and reports
Presentations: Guide students through presenting the project proposals and project reports in groups
activities.assessment_criteria: Project proposals and project reports are well presented

activities.specific_competence: 2.5 Demonstrate mastery of using illustrations in academic documents
activities.learning_activity: (a) Interpret complex illustrations used in various documents
suggested_methods: Scenarios: Guide students through interpreting complex illustrations used in various documents
RIPS (Read-Ink-Pair-Share): Provide students with books, maps, journals, articles and computers for everyone to interpret complex illustrations
activities.assessment_criteria: Complex visual aids used in various documents are interpreted properly

activities.specific_competence: 2.5 Demonstrate mastery of using illustrations in academic documents
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use complex illustrations to prepare academic documents
